channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 15 November
item.description: Diagnostic output was added to the wallet verification process for troubleshooting. Repositories: GeniusWallet, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Saturday 14 November
item.description: A new roadmap and requirements for version 1.2 were documented, and backup processes were updated to support tiered storage. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 13 November
item.description: A submodule named GQHSM was removed from two projects and its documentation updated; storage handling was refined with new logging and retention rules. Repositories: GeniusCognitiveSystem, GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GNUS-NEO-SWARM.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 12 November
item.description: Investor scenario tools gained new lockout calculations and data exports, while the SDK introduced a payout address feature and switched to self‑hosted runners; a numeric input component was also added to the client scaffold. Repositories: gnus-investor-scenarios, GeniusSDK, thirdparty, openapi-client-scaffold, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, libp2p, openapi-cpp-scaffolding.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 11 November
item.description: Milestone testing was completed and related documentation was cleaned up; new payout address features and earnings tracking were added, and request handling was improved with idempotency support. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusWallet, SuperGenius, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, GeniusSDK, CIDocker.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 10 November
item.description: Documentation was added for rotating refresh tokens and design language updates were made, while password handling was secured and build scripts were adjusted for self‑hosted environments. Repositories: openapi-cpp-scaffolding, SuperGenius, GeniusNetwork, gnus-dashboard.
